derivation: contract C2 `hreflang_nonreciprocal` ('the same tag') + A2/A3: A returns B with en, B returns A with en-GB, so each annotation lacks a same-tag return; two findings, one per offending annotation. Both list themselves and resolve canonical to self.

files.a.html:
<!doctype html>
<html><head>
<link rel="canonical" href="https://alpha.example/a">
<link rel="alternate" hreflang="en" href="https://alpha.example/a">
<link rel="alternate" hreflang="en" href="https://beta.example/b">
</head><body></body></html>
files.b.html:
<!doctype html>
<html><head>
<link rel="canonical" href="https://beta.example/b">
<link rel="alternate" hreflang="en-GB" href="https://beta.example/b">
<link rel="alternate" hreflang="en-GB" href="https://alpha.example/a">
</head><body></body></html>

name: nonreciprocal-different-tag
